action.reason: Runner disable can deadlock with project deletion. In fleet-jobs.service.ts, cancelForRunnerDisabled takes job-row locks in ID order, but cancelForProjectDelete takes them in queuedAt order. When two pending-ASSIGN jobs belong to both sweeps and those orders differ, each transaction can hold the row the other needs. PostgreSQL can then roll back the disable or the project cleanup.

rationale: The full branch review and green local gates are not in dispute; this is a separate concurrency blocker. Keep the project cleanup's oldest-first selection and processing, but acquire its selected job locks through the same ID-ordered helper as runner disable. Add a PostgreSQL regression for the overlap before reconsidering promotion. No spec or acceptance change is needed.
